description: Multi-root basis-scoped revocation: P1→A→B grants {read, write} (basis-X); P2→C→B independently grants {read} (basis-Y); revoke(P1→A). B's write (derivable only through the revoked basis-X) must be DENY; B's read (derivable through the still-valid basis-Y) must be ALLOW (SPEC §6b.4).

rule.name: INV-04_multi_root_basis_scoped_revocation
rule.description: A requested action must be derivable from a currently-valid authorization basis; an action derivable only from a revoked basis must not be exercisable

action.reason: requested action not derivable from a currently-valid authorization basis (INV-04 / §6b.4 basis-scoped revocation)
